Russia dismisses Ukraine's election ceasefire proposal

Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov stated that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky does not deserve a respite, in response to Zelensky's proposal for a ceasefire to hold elections in Ukraine. An analyst suggested that Moscow is 'playing with Washington,' following reports that U.S. envoys informed Ukrainian officials that a deal for Russian diesel exports was part of an effort to re-engage Russia in negotiations to end the war.
